name: スペース選択と作成グループ
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0017 スペース選択と作成グループ.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE compact workspace selection/create group, original region24,486,342,176 normalized. Preserve Japanese adaptation exactly: first row avatar 灯, name ライトハウスのスペース, subtitle 標準プラン; second row avatar 学, name 学びのスペース, subtitle 無料プラン; third row 新しいスペース. Name/action text Meiryo REGULAR40014/24, metadata12/16, tracking0. Original source controls avatar proportions and fine details, selection check and creation glyph. First avatar has a small red rounded notification badge with exact numeral1 at its upper-right, as in ORIGINAL (mock omitted it); preserve that meaningful visible state. White avatars with fine neutral outline, slate Japanese initials; no mint fills. SECOND workspace selected, shown by source-style simple check at far right in forest green. No check on first. Third row has ORIGINAL plus INSIDE a circle, NOT mock's bare plus, slate coherent stroke. Single white rounded group with subtle neutral outline and soft downward shadow on pure-white canvas; no tinted outer panel. Align avatar/name baselines, keep two text lines per workspace and compact generous touch rows. No extra account header/email, Add account, log out, phone or background workspace content from original. Uniform enlargement into readable landscape around1400x900 with restrained margins. Preserve source notification badge color as functional count; no other colored decorative icons.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Retain red#B8473E badge1 because it conveys source notification state. Adapt second-row selected check to forest green; utility plus/avatars remain slate on white with no mint.
reviewNotes: 原版のbadge1と丸内plusを復元、whiteavatar/2行目選択/5日本語runを目視確認。badgeは機能的red、選択checkは森緑、補助slate。要修正:badge形状が原版の角丸四角から円に変わったため形のみ対象修正。実操作/font同一性/native編集/所有者承認なし。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
